description: Handoff inputs from MC-19 to MC-20 (product catalog batch 1: NAV, HUB, AIS). MC-20 has not started and is not authorized by this document. The inputs record what MC-20 may rely on, what MC-19 delivered as internal preview only, and what MC-20 must not assume.

availableInputs.input: MC-17 design system (48 Angular components + 1 directive)
MC-18 bilingual landing patterns and isolated preview
MC-16 canonical product data contract and generated projection
MC-15 proposed route registry (23 routes, 9 family routes, 6 bundle routes)
MC-14 claims policy and release-evidence gates
MC-18 independent audit and delivery conclusions
MC-19 internal audience-page pattern: one bilingual component tree, eight sections, evidence-bound copy, fail-closed CTA, internal preview namespace
MC-19 deterministic content projection and validator pattern

mustNotAssume: That the MC-19 audience pages have any public route, canonical, hreflang, sitemap entry or indexable metadata; they are internal preview only.
That a public shipowner route exists or is approved; it does not, and no public path is reserved.
That any price, stock, SKU, purchase, subscription or delivery capability exists; all products remain NOT_FOR_SALE.
That any lead capture, enquiry form, contact endpoint or installer registration exists; the privacy gate is blocked.
That any installer, distributor or partner programme, accreditation or agreement exists; DOC-17 is NOT_EXECUTED.
That any trademark, public-use, source-IP, licensing, publication or deployment authorisation exists.
That MC-19 acceptance criteria extended to publication, indexation or commercial activation; they do not.
That MC-20 may reuse the MC-19 internal preview namespace as a public path.

missingInputs.input: Approved public segment-page copy and route activation
missingInputs.reason: MC-19 pages are internal draft copy in an internal namespace; publication and indexation are not authorised.
MC-19 deliberately implements no solution or bundle pages; MC-20–MC-23 retain that ownership.
MC-18/MC-19 conventions exist (evidence-bound blocks, fixed literals, one bilingual source) but no catalog-specific contract was added.

missingInputs.input: Shared SEO activation decision for future MAREA pages
missingInputs.reason: No route is activated or authorized.

mc20EntryConditions: MC-20 Master Prompt issued and bound to a scope revision.
MC-20 IA decision for the nine family pages, reusing MC-15 proposed routes and the MC-16 product data contract.
MC-17 design system and the MC-18/MC-19 bilingual component patterns reused, not forked.
Every family page stays preview-only and non-indexable until the publication gates and a release authorization record exist.
No price, stock, SKU, purchase, lead, certification, compatibility or installability claim is introduced.
Inherited debt remains visible; FINANCIAL_V18 is still open and MC16_FINAL_02 is open until re-verified.
nonAuthorization: This handoff does not start MC-20, does not assign MC-20 owners or dates and does not approve any MC-20 route, page, price, claim or publication.
